title: Orchard Catch
brief: Slide the basket under falling fruit: cherries drift down slowly, melons drop fast and score the most. Reach 50 before sunset; three wasp stings and you lose.

title: Rockslide
brief: Boulders bounce down the canyon trail from the right and quick scree hops in from the left. Drag the ranger to run, tap the sky to jump over them, and let 25 rocks roll past to win; three hits bury you.

title: Soap Float
brief: A soap bubble keeps rising faster and faster through the kitchen; blow it left or right and tap HOLD to stop it, slipping past knives, a sliding fork and dripping water. Float out of the skylight to win; pop three times and you lose.

title: Circus Juggler
brief: Slide the clown's paddle to keep the juggling balls bouncing in the ring; hit them off-centre to angle them, send them through the moving hoop for bonus points, and new balls join at 10 and 22. Reach 35 for a standing ovation; drop three balls and the crowd boos.

title: Crane Stacker
brief: Tap DROP to release a crate from the moving crane trolley and stack eight floors on the small foundation; the trolley speeds up as the tower grows. A crate that misses lands in the mud and the stack starts over; a crate hit by the swinging wrecking ball ends the game.

title: Human Cannonball
brief: Fire the daredevil from the circus cannon with a LOW, MID or HIGH shot and time it so the arc lands in the sliding net, while a bobbing bunch of balloons can knock the flight short. Six catches make you the star; three falls into the sawdust send the crowd home.

title: Sky Drop
brief: Free-fall through the wind, tap anywhere to open the parachute and drag the skydiver onto the target: the red centre scores 3, the yellow rings 1, and opening below the low line adds a +2 bravery bonus. A gull can tear the canopy shut; land without an open chute three times and you are grounded, score 15 to win.

title: Puffer Ballast
brief: A pufferfish swims on its own through a long reef with a sinking pull: swipe up to puff and rise, down to deflate and dive, ride the bubble vents, and dodge urchins, stalactites and bobbing squid. Reach the grotto at the far end to win; pearls earn back lives, three hits and you are puffed out.

title: Firework Festival
brief: Paper lanterns drift across the night sky; tap the three launch tubes to send rockets up their columns, where they burst into embers after one second. Light 20 lanterns for the grand finale; let six drift away and the festival is over.

title: Rink Rebound
brief: Shoot the puck straight or bank it off the side boards past a sliding defender and a pacing goalie; each shot plays out for four seconds of ricochets before the whistle. Score six goals with ten pucks to win; run out of pucks and you lose.

title: Lily Leap
brief: Hop a frog across two ponds with BACK, HOP and LEAP arcs, landing on lily pads that flash red and sink for a moment; in the second pond a swan swats you out of the air. Reach the far bank of the second pond to win; fall in the water four times and the frog is gone (every three flies eaten gives a life back).

title: Candy Sorter
brief: Pink berry and blue mint candies tumble down three zigzag conveyor belts onto a sorting plate; tap PINK or BLUE to choose which way the plate kicks the next candy. Sort 20 into the right bins to win; three candies in the wrong bin shut the line down.

title: Crater Golf
brief: Low-gravity golf over three lunar holes: pick PUTT, CHIP, LOB, DRIVE or BACK and the ball flies its arc, stopping dead where it lands in the dust; bank shots off the crater walls, a cliff, a drifting boulder and a rover. Land on the green of all three holes to win; balls lost in a crater cost a penalty stroke, and running out of the 15 shared strokes loses.

title: Jungle Temple
brief: Guide a monkey up three stone temples: drag it to walk and swipe up, left or right to jump, collecting every banana to drop the gate in front of the idol; in the last temple a mushroom flings you to the top. Falling into the river restarts the temple (and its bananas); a spider, snake or bat bite ends the run, and the golden idol wins it.

title: Hardhat Crossing
brief: A construction worker walks across three building sites on his own; tap each dashed gap to drop a girder before he reaches it, and use STOP and GO to time him past the crane hook and the falling rivets. Reach the site office on the third site to win; the eight girders must last all three sites, and three falls or hits close the site.

title: Moon Courier
brief: Puff a cargo drone around a low-gravity moon base with three thrusters that only add speed: land on the mine pad to load ore and bring it back to the base pad, refuelling on the mesa, while dodging antennas and falling meteors. Deliver five loads to win; three crashes scrap the drone.

title: Ice Marble
brief: Push a frictionless marble up three icy cliffs: each swipe adds a push in that direction and a tap on the marble brakes it, while ice ledges catch it from above and bounce it from below. Climb through the gaps that alternate sides, hop over the cracks and past posts and a snowplough to reach the golden cup on each cliff; five marbles lost in cracks and the game is over.
